listing.name: Banjo-Tooie / Banjo-Tooie: Recompiled (Vidanox)
listing.summary: Explore Banjo-Tooie / Banjo-Tooie: Recompiled (Vidanox) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep an existing permitted copy
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted, prepared copy, choose its BanjoTooieRecompiled.exe game executable and supplied working folder in the existing-installation review. Use your own supported USA Banjo-Tooie big-endian .z64 in Select ROM. The runtime needs the supplied assets folder in its working directory. Default Windows data stays under LocalAppData/BanjoTooieRecompiled. Saving those launch details does not run it; launch separately when ready.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with upstream
steps.instruction: Retain the working folder and original game files. Follow the selected upstream version’s update instructions using a separate replacement folder. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime or its user-profile data.
